jobs.title: Digital Project Manager
jobs.description:
Third & Arch is looking for a tech-savvy Digital Project Manager who’s comfortable wearing many hats, juggling multiple projects, and thrives working in a fast-paced environment. Think you’ve got what it takes? Read on.

The Digital Project Manager will have at least 2-3 years of relevant agency experience and be primarily responsible for managing branding and website design & development projects from inception through completion. We are looking for a self-starter who is highly motivated, passionate, and ready to hit the ground running. Please, let's respect each other's time. If you do not have relevant experience managing projects at a branding, web design, and/or marketing agency, please DO NOT APPLY. You will not be considered for this position and it's a waste of time and effort for all parties involved.

Key Responsibilities:
Assist the project team in defining a project approach that best suits our clients’ needs
Create and execute project plans and revise them as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
Manage day-to-day operational aspects of assigned projects and scope including project budgets and timelines
Identify risks and resolve them pro-actively with consideration for short and long term project impact
Prioritize and track the progress of multiple projects, ensuring deadlines are met
Provide regular updates to clients and internal teams on project status
Manage day-to-day client interaction, including setting and managing client expectations and documenting client meetings
Coordinate with our internal teams to ensure timely and accurate execution of tasks
Participate in revenue and resource forecasting
Assist with testing & QA to ensure all deliverables meet the project requirements and are free of errors

Qualifications & Requirements:
Proven experience as a Project Manager or similar role in a brand and web design or digital agency environment
Strong understanding of web technologies, CMS platforms (WordPress), and typical website functionality
Excellent organizational skills with an ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Exceptional communication and client service skills
Problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure
A good knowledge of the latest trends in the tech industry, including regulations (i.e. ADA Compliance)
Ability to work well within a remote team environment
An understanding of basic SEO principles
Ability to track budgets, timelines, and deadlines
Ability to keep an open mind when listening to feedback
Completely at home on a Mac and proficient with a variety of tools and apps (Slack, Google, Asana, Team Gantt, ChatGPT, etc.)
Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or public relations

Important Application Details
Third & Arch is a remote company and we are accepting applicants nationwide. As our team works from home offices, relocation is not necessary. Must be a US Citizen based in the United States. This is a full-time position but we will accept applications from contractors seeking a temp-to-perm arrangement.

Compensation
Compensation to be discussed and determined based on relevant experience.

Benefits
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Holidays, Personal Days)
401k Plan with 3% Company Match (must complete a full year of employment to be eligible)
Remote Work with Semi-Flexible Hours
Remote Agency Retreats
Group Health Insurance Plan
Dental & Vision Insurance Plans
Paid Professional Development
Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us
Third & Arch is an innovative branding agency focused on leading AEC firms. We provide creative services including brand strategy, web design, and custom website development for clients who demand fresh ideas and real-world results.

Next Steps
Fill out the application form below or email us to introduce yourself: jobs@thirdandarch.com. Be sure to include your resumé, rate requirements, and link to your online portfolio. https://www.thirdandarch.com/careers-project-manager/

Projectmanager Meetings, BCD Meetings & Events België

Fulltime | Homebased in België

Ben jij een sterke organisator met feeling voor hospitality, events en klantrelaties? Dan is deze rol als Projectmanager Meetings bij BCD Meetings & Events België misschien wel iets voor jou.

Als projectmanager ben jij de schakel tussen de meeting planner van de klant en het hotel of de leverancier. Je begeleidt het traject van locatiesearch en contractering tot en met de planningsfase van de bijeenkomst. Daarbij bouw je sterke klantrelaties op en zorg je ervoor dat alles vlot, professioneel en tot in de puntjes verloopt.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onder andere locatieonderzoek, selectie, offerteaanvragen, budgettering, onderhandelingen, contractafsluiting en het in kaart brengen van besparingen. Afhankelijk van het programma kunnen daar ook taken bij komen zoals deelnemersregistratie, websiteontwikkeling, programmaorganisatie, on-site ondersteuning en afstemming met alle betrokken partijen.

De programma’s waaraan je werkt, variëren van 10 tot 500 deelnemers. Je komt terecht in een team met open communicatielijnen en een flexibele manier van samenwerken. Tegelijk neem jij eigenaarschap over je projecten en zorg je ervoor dat processen correct worden gevolgd en dat jij voor jouw klant dé expert bent.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Je onderzoekt de beschikbaarheid van hotels en locaties op basis van de specificaties van het programma.
Je stelt, waar nodig via meetingtechnologie, voorlopige tarieven, beschikbaarheidsoverzichten en programmabudgetten op om de klant te ondersteunen bij de keuze van de juiste locatie.
Je onderhandelt contracten met hotels en locaties.
Je bespreekt en onderhandelt aanvullende, klantspecifieke voorwaarden met leveranciers en venues.
Je werkt samen met de klant rond het betalen van hotelvoorschotten.
Je onderhoudt dagelijks je relaties binnen de sector.
Je maakt optimaal gebruik van de voorkeursafspraken van klanten met hotels tijdens contractonderhandelingen.
Je plant en woont, indien nodig, bezoeken aan leveranciers bij.
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en correctheid van technologische gegevens.
Je onderzoekt voorkeursleveranciers voor offerteaanvragen en formuleert indien nodig aanbevelingen.
Je volgt hotelovernachtingen, uitgaven en gerealiseerde besparingen op en rapporteert hierover nauwkeurig.

Jij brengt mee

Bij voorkeur een bacheloropleiding of gelijkwaardige ervaring, idealiter met een zakelijke insteek en ondernemende mindset.
Ervaring in de eventsector; kennis van Cvent is een mooie plus.
Inzicht in verschillende soorten meetings en de specifieke aandachtspunten die daarbij horen.
Een goede algemene kennis van bestemmingen, hotels en leveranciers.
Sterke mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands, Engels en Frans.
Ervaring binnen een bureau gespecialiseerd in meeting management is een extra troef.
Ervaring met klanten uit de farmaceutische sector is een plus.

Wat je mag verwachten Voor deze functie ligt het bruto jaarsalaris tussen €40.000 en €50.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring, skills en kwalificaties.

De sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats in de tweede helft van augustus.

Project Manager Meetings Management, BCD Meetings & Events Belgium

Full-time, (home) based in Belgium

The Project Manager owns and manages client relationships and will serve as the liaison between the clients meeting planner and the hotel/supplier during the sourcing and contracting phase of the meeting and during the planning phase.

You are primarily responsible for site research, selection, RFP development, value-added client counseling, budgeting, negotiations, contracting, and savings consolidation. Additional responsibilities may include attendee registration, website development, program organization, onsite management, and reconciliation.

Programs will vary in scopes and sizes from 10 attendees to 500 attendees. Communication lines within the team are open and flexible, and you will be responsible for following all processes appropriately and being your Client's subject matter expert.

Your Responsibilities

Source hotel/venue availability based on the program specifications. Provide (via meetings technology) preliminary rate, availability grids, and preliminary program budgets, as required to assist the Client meeting sponsor in making a final decision on program location.
Negotiate hotel and venue contracts.
Effectively be able to negotiate Client specific addendum with vendors and venues.
Work with the Client on hotel deposit payments.
Manage day-to-day industry relationships.
Utilize and leverage Client preferred hotel agreements when negotiating hotel contracts.
Schedule and attend supplier visits as required.
Ensure technology data integrity.
Research preferred suppliers to include in RFP responses and provide recommendations

potentially.

Track and report hotel room nights, spending, and savings; ensure technology data integrity.

You're good at

BA preferred or similar level of experience with a business focus and entrepreneurial spirit.
Prior event experience and Cvent knowledge is preferred
Understanding of meeting types and associated considerations
General understanding of destinations, hotels, and suppliers
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, Dutch and French
Agency experience in the meetings management fields is a plus
Experience with pharma clients is preferred

The salary range for the role is between 40.000 euro and 50.000 euro gross per year. The actual pay will depends on your qualifications, skills and experience.

Interviews will take place in the third week of August.

THE PERKS

Flexible Working

We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best.

Room to Grow

Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

Everyone has a voice

We thrive on conversations that spark curiosity and empathy. No matter how big or how small, every voice is heard, considered and respected.

Make your move

The diversity of roles across BCD M&E’s global locations means that our people often find new adventures during their time with us. Join us as a meeting planner role in the UK, stay for a global marketing career — there’s always room to move.

We’ve got you covered

Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.

It starts from the top. Our leaders lead with positivity, believe in our people and trust us to do the right thing. There will always be support along your journey, in little and big ways.

This is an immediate remote term opportunity for a seasoned IT project professional with a proven track record delivering complex technology implementations in clinical environments.

Responsibilities

Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of a large-scale Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online implementation/migration project.
Manage project scope, timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, and deliverables.
Provide regular project status reporting to the Project Steering Committee and senior leadership.
Coordinate internal project teams, vendor partners, clinical resources, business stakeholders, and customers.
Ensure technology solutions are implemented safely and effectively within a clinical healthcare environment.
Coordinate the implementation and migration from on-premise email services to Microsoft Exchange Online.
Lead or coordinate testing of Microsoft 365 products and services, including Exchange Online.
Ensure appropriate testing, validation, issue resolution, and readiness activities are completed prior to implementation.
Develop and execute organizational change management strategies and plans.
Work with clinical and business teams to ensure staff are adequately prepared for new technology and processes.
Identify and manage project risks, issues, and barriers to successful delivery.
Ensure project activities align with established project management and change management methodologies.

Qualifications
Valid PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner certification is required.
10+ years of experience managing information technology projects within a healthcare environment.
Experience reporting project progress to a Project Steering Committee and overseeing the safe implementation of software solutions within a clinical environment.
7+ years of experience coordinating internal delivery teams, vendor partners, and customer stakeholders to successfully deliver digital business outcomes.
5+ years of experience implementing or migrating organizations to Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online within a large acute-care healthcare or public sector environment.
Experience coordinating Microsoft 365 implementations with clinical, business, and management resources and ensuring staff are adequately prepared for new solutions.
5+ years of experience directly testing or coordinating the testing of Microsoft 365 products and services, including Exchange Online migrations from on-premise mail services.
5+ years of experience using a structured change management methodology, such as Prosci, to develop and deliver organizational change management strategies and plans.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Proven ability to manage complex projects involving multiple teams, vendors, and competing priorities.

jobs.title: Commissioning Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
For over 45 years, CEQEL Critical Commissioning (CCCx) has been at the forefront of mission-critical commissioning services. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement has made us a trusted partner for complex facilities across various industries.

We combine decades of experience with cutting-edge technology to deliver reliable, efficient, and compliant commissioning services that meet the evolving needs of mission-critical environments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

Commissioning Senior Project Manager

Position Location:

Remote - work from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major airport.

Travel Requirements:

Up to 75% domestic travel; relocation may be considered for long-term project needs.

Job Summary

The Commissioning Senior Project Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities on a programmatic basis. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems, with a focus on higher level programmatic details.

The Commissioning Senior Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of the project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

The role includes developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws and specifications.

The Commissioning Senior Project Manager will be self-directed on day-to-day work and independently performs most responsibilities. Will lead project teams of complex scope and broader programs. Will coordinate activities of other personnel. Assists in the development of policies and procedures.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Manage all Elements of Commissioning Projects (50%)

Manage pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
Coordinate resource and material forecasting
Develop, manage and monitor schedule
Participate in, schedule and lead project meetings
Coordinate / perform QA / QC and Cx plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals
Communicate and coordinate project staffing needs
Oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout
Onboard project team for mobilization
Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
Lead preparation of final commissioning report for submission to client
Develop testing plans and procedures for complex projects

Monitor and Control Project Financials (20%)

Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall responsibility for the profitability of the project
Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required
Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines

Manage Stakeholder Relations (25%)

Prepare proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
Promote firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
Support contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
Ensure client satisfaction through active communication

Perform On-site Commissioning Activities (5%)

Perform on-site commissioning activities including inspection, testing, troubleshooting, and equipment validation for electrical and mechanical systems
Use technical testing equipment and coordinate vendors/contractors during execution
Ensure assigned tasks and deliverables are completed on time and within budget
Strong knowledge of commissioning, construction procedures, project management, and industry best practices
Skilled in resource allocation, personnel management, strategic planning, and team coordination
Experience with materials, methods, and tools used in mission critical and commercial construction projects
Detail-oriented with strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in both onsite and remote environments
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including direct client interaction and reporting
Capable of managing deadlines, delegating work, and handling multiple priorities simultaneously
Proficient in MS Office Suite and adaptable to client/industry-specific software
Committed to company and site safety requirements

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

In-depth knowledge of electrical, mechanical and controls system principles
Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with minimal supervision
Ability to lead project teams of complex scope and coordinate the activities of other personnel
Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
Ability to achieve certification for NFPA70E and / or OSHA training as / if required
Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools.
Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
Frequently moving through various environments, including critical facilities, low / high temperatures, and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind.
Frequently required to ascend/ descend stairs and ladders and move through tight or confined spaces to access equipment.
On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment.
On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to rent vehicles and have valid driver’s license

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Who are you?

Turner & Townsend
is seeking an experienced Project Manager

Reporting to the Project Delivery leadership team, you will play a key role in managing complex projects from initiation through close-out, ensuring delivery excellence across scope, schedule, budget, and stakeholder expectations. As a trusted project leader, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project execution, maintain governance standards, manage project risks, and measure value realization. Lead project handover and close-out activities, ensuring all deliverables are completed, documented, and transitioned effectively to operational stakeholders.

3-5+ years of project management experience, with demonstrated success delivering complex projects from initiation through close-out. Previous experience managing end-to-end projects within the construction, real estate, workplace, or capital projects environment is considered a strong asset.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Construction Management, Real Estate, or a related field. PMP certification is considered a strong asset.

Experience with Smartsheet or comparable project management platforms.

Proficiency with Google Workspace (or similar productivity tools) and the ability to quickly learn new systems and technologies.

Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage competing stakeholder interests, and drive projects to successful outcomes.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with expertise in project reporting, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
Our team plays a crucial role in ensuring the company’s success. We seek people who are willing to learn and put in the effort to solve problems. Our challenges are not your regular day-to-day problems - you’ll be part of a team that’s developing new solutions to new challenges. It’s working fast, at scale, and we’re making a difference. We are looking for talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech and Product PMO team based in San Jose. You'll drive the end-to-end tasks that keep the systems behind TikTok running and work with various team members to deliver best user experiences and highest-standard user privacy. As a TPM, you’ll be the bridge between various teams and drive collaboration tasks across teams.
- Work closely with global cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, and Sales in the US and mandarin-speaking countries to drive the end-to-end delivery of new products, services, and/or features to market.
- Manage a variety of complex, cross-functional programs and lead all aspects of assigned programs delivery.
- Create and maintain the Roadmap for the teams by working with the respective Tech and Product leaders.
- Define the way of driving the programs and constantly find ways to improve the process in a data-driven manner.
- Prepare the project schedule, define the milestones, and be the owner of the collaboration process and tools.
- Track and report progress, identify and mitigate risks, and remove blockers.
- Ensure products and applications release to market smoothly.
- Mentor and help develop the team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Must have a technical educational background, such as a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 3 years of relevant work experience in project/program management or software development leadership.
- Must have at least 1 year of experience in each of the following: Leading Agile development processes, managing software development projects, including building development processes and coordinating release schedules, or creating and maintaining software development roadmaps for engineering teams.
- Managing stakeholder relationships and gathering feedback to build programs that support customer revenue, growth, and retention.
- Planning and executing projects using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.
- Experience operating in fast-paced environments and managing multiple priorities across time zones.
- Passion for problem-solving, process optimization, and delivering results in a data-driven and iterative way.
- Growth mindset with a willingness to take initiative and adapt in a constantly evolving environment.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

jobs.description:
What MatX Is Building

MatX is on a mission to be the compute platform for AGI. We are developing vertically integrated full-stack solutions from silicon to systems including hardware and software to train and run the largest ML workloads for AGI. MatX is seeking silicon micro-architects and design engineers to join our team as we create best-in-class silicon for high-performance and sustainable GenAI. Successful candidates for these roles will be responsible for delivering performant and functionally accurate silicon for MatX products across compute, memory management. High-speed connectivity and other key technologies.

About The Role

MatX is building next-generation AI infrastructure systems for high-performance datacenter workloads. We are looking for a Senior NPI TPM, Rack-Scale AI Systems
to manage integrated execution for rack and board platforms, spanning engineering builds through the final production ramp.

In this capacity, you will serve as the primary interface for manufacturing execution with external CM/JDM partners. You will coordinate workstreams across material readiness, PLM/BOM/ECO control, factory test deployment, quality metrics, and high-volume ramp readiness for high-performance AI infrastructure.

What You'll Do Here

Direct the integrated NPI lifecycle for rack and board platforms, spanning engineering builds through the final volume production ramp.
Act as the primary technical interface for manufacturing execution with external CM/JDM partners to ensure factory readiness.
Manage master build schedules, configuration matrices, and unit allocation while leading formal build-readiness governance.
Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across PLM, BOM control, ECOs, material readiness, and shipment logistics.
Oversee integrated execution across PCBA, high-power modules, liquid-cooled trays, and complex rack-level systems.
Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to finalize DFX requirements, serviceability standards, and factory-flow optimization.
Partner with test teams to deploy diagnostics, power characterization, and data-capture infrastructure prior to build kick-off.
Define metrics and dashboards to track first-pass yield, quality gates, and corrective actions throughout the development cycle.
Engage with Supply Chain to mitigate risks associated with long-lead semiconductor components and material shortages.
Lead ECO tracking and revision effectiveness, serving as the central point for build-level change communication.
Prepare executive-level reporting that summarizes technical risks, material gaps, and high-volume ramp readiness.
Ensure critical learnings from validation phases are captured in playbooks to drive predictable production-readiness plans.

Who You Are

8+ years of technical program management, NPI program management, manufacturing operations, hardware operations, or engineering program management experience.
Experience driving complex hardware builds through EVT, DVT, PVT, production readiness, and ramp.
Experience working with CM, JDM, ODM, or rack-scale manufacturing partners on build planning, factory readiness, issue closure, and manufacturing execution.
Experience with BOMs, AVLs, ECOs, configuration management, DFM/DFA/DFT, PCBA manufacturing, final assembly, factory test, and quality systems.
Experience tracking manufacturing KPIs such as first-pass yield, defect pareto, rework rate, test pass rate, build cycle time, and quality escapes.
Ability to drive schedules, risk management, issue tracking, milestone governance, and executive-level communication.
Strong cross-functional leadership across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, test, and external partner teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize build risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and schedule impact.
Proficiency with program-management and engineering collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, Google Workspace, or equivalent.

Bonus Points If You Have

Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU/accelerator systems, datacenter racks, networking systems, storage systems, or high-power server platforms.
Experience coordinating programs involving rack-scale integration, liquid-cooled systems, high-speed interconnects, factory diagnostics, or system-level validation.
Prior hands-on experience in hardware, manufacturing, test, quality, supply chain, or NPI operations is a plus.

Compensation

The US base salary for this full-time position is determined based on a variety of factors including role, experience, location, job related skills, and relevant education and training. Career length is only a guideline for compensation.

Early Career - $120,000 - $250,000 + equity
Mid Career - $175,000 - $362,500 + equity
Senior Career - $250,000 - $475,000 + equity

What We Offer

Time off: 4 weeks PTO (accrued) + 12 company Holidays + up to 3 weeks remote work
Health: Company-subsidized Medical (Kaiser or Anthem) for employees & dependents, Guardian Dental and Vision insurances for employee & dependents, and life insurance (employee only), plus HSA and FSA offerings via Lively. See attached benefits 1-pager and full benefits guide for more info on benefits.
Financial Wellbeing: Choose from Roth IRA/ 401K (or both) retirement plans with up to 5% company contribution to 401K (even if you don't contribute). Also, 100% company-paid life insurance (up to $300K) and long-term disability insurances.
Professional Development: $1500 Professional Development Budget (per year)

Commute on Us: Commute on our company Uber account, or reimburse your train rides. Either way, we pay 100% for your daily commute.
MatX E[x]tras: $50/mo to use on the perk you value most
Cell & Internet Reimbursement: $35/mo for cellular and $40/mo for wifi
Mental Wellbeing: 100% paid mental health benefit via SpringHealth and Guardian EAP.
Support to Parents: Up to 12 weeks paid parental leave regardless of path to parenthood, 10 weeks pregnancy disability leave, flexible return-to-work hours, and Benepass reproductive health & parental benefit.
AI Resources: Up to $20K/month plus a dedicated internal AI Tooling Team to support your productivity

As part of our dedication to the diversity of our team and our focus on creating an inviting and inclusive work experience, MatX is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, genetic information or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and work from our offices in Mountain View Tuesdays-Thursdays.

At Outform Group, our guiding philosophy is Dare To Innovate.

Outform Group specializes in creating tangible consumer engagements that elevate, connect and humanize brand experiences. We unite leading experts in research, strategy, design, innovation and manufacturing, who work together to create unforgettable brand experiences.

Lean, interdisciplinary teams work in close collaboration with clients, helping them to solve their user’s biggest problems. Our user-centric, data-driven approach focuses on creating a seamless experience across different environments.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager
to own and drive complex, high‑visibility technology initiatives from concept through global deployment.

This role requires a seasoned technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, navigates complexity with ease, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to deeply understand technologies that power modern retail experiences. Curiosity, technical breadth, and strong execution discipline are essential.

DIRECT REPORTS

None

SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY

This role owns the full lifecycle of complex, high-visibility technology programs—from initial scoping and architecture through global deployment and long-term support. The Senior Technical Project Manager serves as the central technical authority and primary client-facing leader for large-scale retail technology initiatives, with initial focus on multi-phase LED video wall programs for a major retail brand. This position carries direct accountability for program outcomes across scope, timeline, budget, and quality, while simultaneously building and maintaining high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones. The role operates with significant autonomy and is expected to make high-impact decisions that shape both client experience and internal capability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Oversight

Provide senior-level oversight across multiple concurrent technology programs, ensuring technical feasibility, design excellence, and flawless execution within scope, timeline, and budget.
Evaluate project opportunities, define high-level architecture, determine resource needs, and guide teams through complex decision-making.
Lead the development and integration of hardware, software, and physical display systems, ensuring seamless performance in demanding retail environments.
Build and maintain high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones.
Define technical requirements, develop comprehensive technology BOMs, and guide sourcing, procurement, and estimation strategies.

Program & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, translating their goals into actionable technical plans and delivering executive-level communication.
Oversee large-scale project roadmaps, risk mitigation strategies, and milestone tracking across multiple parallel workstreams.
Maintain and evolve technical documentation, including wiring schematics, integration maps, digital die lines, and BOMs.
Define and implement documentation standards, QA processes, and best practices for installation, support, and troubleshooting.
Lead internal and external status meetings, delivering clear updates to senior stakeholders.

Hands-On Technical Execution

Personally evaluate, test, and validate technology solutions as part of pre-sale exploration, prototyping, and client demonstrations.
Build quick-turn prototypes and technology demos that support new business development and innovation initiatives.
Act as a tier-two escalation point for complex troubleshooting, ensuring issues are resolved swiftly and root causes are understood.
Partner with technology vendors to scope, assess, and co-develop solutions tailored for retail activation.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

Operate as the central hub between engineering, design, production, sourcing, and client teams—translating technical details into clear, actionable insights.
Foster an inclusive and collaborative environment that encourages experimentation, knowledge sharing, and creative problem-solving.
Anticipate communication gaps and proactively bridge them across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to scaling technical project management capabilities across the organization.

KEY INTERFACES (NON-REPORTING)

This role collaborates consistently with the following teams and functions outside its direct reporting structure: Engineering and Software Development teams (hardware/software integration), Design and Creative teams (retail experience and display design), Production and Fabrication teams (manufacturing and physical build), Sourcing and Procurement teams (vendor and component management), Client stakeholders and executive sponsors, Technology Vendors and LED/digital signage suppliers, Global Manufacturing Partners (including production facilities in China), and Installation and Field Support teams.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Success in this role will be measured against metrics including but not limited to:
On-time and on-budget delivery rate across assigned technology programs
Client satisfaction scores and retention on managed accounts
Prototype and demo quality as measured by client approval and conversion
Speed and effectiveness of issue resolution (escalation response time)
Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation (BOMs, schematics, integration maps)
Cross-functional team feedback on communication clarity and collaboration
Adherence to QA standards and reduction in post-installation defects

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent work experience accepted.
Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical project management role within experiential, retail, hardware, software, or systems integration environments.

Technical Knowledge

Strong foundation in both hardware and software systems with ability to engage in deep technical discussions
Prior experience with LED systems, digital signage, and retail technology highly preferred
Familiarity with wiring schematics, integration maps, and technology BOMs
Hands-on technical aptitude (e.g., PC building, coding, home networking, video editing, or interactive technology tinkering)

Program Management Skills

Proven track record managing large, multi-stakeholder programs with competing priorities
Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation, QA processes, and installation standards
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

Communication & Leadership

Exceptional communication and leadership presence with demonstrated client-facing skills
Ability to translate complex technical information for non-technical audiences
Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders

Other Requirements

Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time (domestic and international, including China)
Availability for weekly calls with teams in China across time zones

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES & PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

Strategic & Innovative Thinker: Approaches problems with a forward-thinking mindset, comfortable owning high-impact decisions and operating with autonomy in ambiguous situations.
Exceptional Communicator: Able to simplify technical complexity for any audience—from engineers to C-suite executives—with clarity, confidence, and precision.
Trust Builder: Earns credibility through deep preparation, technical intelligence, and consistent execution. Develops high-trust relationships with clients, vendors, and internal teams alike.
Relentless Problem Solver: Thrives under pressure with a track record of delivering results. Approaches obstacles with a solutions-oriented mindset and never leaves an issue unresolved.
Collaborative Influencer: Skilled at guiding cross-functional decisions and rallying diverse teams behind a shared goal without formal authority.
Passionate About Retail Technology: Genuinely energized by leveraging technology to create best-in-class customer experiences in physical retail environments.
Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: Consistently meets deadlines, maintains rigorous documentation standards, and keeps complex programs on track simultaneously.
Self-Driven & Proactive: Takes initiative without being prompted, anticipates needs before they arise, and is energized by building what doesn’t yet exist.
Positive Can-Do Attitude: Willing to jump in wherever and whenever needed, bringing energy and optimism to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Essential Functions

Working conditions are in a normal office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk, sit, and stand, using hands to handle, finger, or feel objects, tools, or controls. Occasionally, the employee must crouch or kneel. The employee must occasionally exert or lift up to 20 pounds. Successful performance requires good eyesight with or without corrective lenses. Overview

LMI is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager (TPM)
to work onsite at Fort Bragg and lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of a mission-critical technical program supporting U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM). The TPM will integrate the work of cross-functional technical teams, translate mission priorities into executable plans, and ensure delivery against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and performance commitments.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined, mission-focused leader who can operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, communicate with senior government and corporate stakeholders, and remove barriers for engineers and delivery teams. Success requires sound judgment, strong program controls, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt quickly as operational and technical priorities evolve.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

This position is located onsite at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, and requires an active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.

Responsibilities

Lead day-to-day planning, execution, and delivery of a complex technical program supporting USSOCOM mission requirements.
Translate government priorities and technical objectives into integrated project plans, milestones, work packages, and measurable outcomes.
Enable cross-functional teams—including software, platform, data, cybersecurity, engineering, and operations personnel—to deliver high-quality capabilities on schedule.
Establish and maintain program controls for scope, schedule, cost, staffing, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and contract deliverables.
Monitor program performance, identify emerging execution risks, and drive timely mitigation, escalation, and corrective action.
Coordinate priorities, resource assignments, and delivery timelines with technical leads, product owners, program leadership, and government stakeholders.
Support Agile delivery through backlog refinement, sprint and release planning, milestone reviews, and continuous improvement of team execution practices.
Prepare and deliver executive-level briefings, monthly status reports, financial and schedule updates, technical review materials, meeting minutes, decision records, and after-action reports.
Manage client engagements and working sessions; document requirements, decisions, action items, owners, and completion criteria to maintain accountability and alignment.
Ensure deliverables are accurate, timely, complete, and compliant with contract requirements, government direction, and LMI policies and quality standards.
Foster a collaborative, accountable team culture focused on mission outcomes, transparent communication, and delivery excellence.
Respond rapidly to evolving operational needs and perform other program leadership duties required to sustain mission execution.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business, project management, or a related discipline.
Minimum of five years of progressively responsible project or program management experience, including leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams in a federal, defense, or GovTech environment.
Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
Prior military service or direct experience supporting Special Operations Forces (SOF) at the operational or headquarters level.
Working knowledge of Department of War (DoW) acquisition, cybersecurity, information technology (IT), and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes.
Proven ability to manage scope, integrated schedules, budgets, staffing, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across concurrent technical workstreams.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT M'RHEN

M'RHEN is a New York–and Taipei–based luxury womenswear brand focused on refined femininity, emotional resonance, and intentional craftsmanship. Produced in New York City, the brand is known for its elevated tailoring, feminine silhouettes, and intimate approach to luxury.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, highly organized, and resourceful Executive & Business Operations Manager
to work directly alongside our Founder & Creative Director and serve as an operational right hand across M'RHEN.
This is a highly hands-on role at the center of a growing luxury fashion company. You will own key day-to-day business operations while providing the executive support that enables the founder and broader team to operate effectively. Your scope will span business and financial administration, executive operations, inventory and ecommerce, showroom and client experience, and special projects.
We are looking for someone who doesn't simply execute tasks, but creates structure, identifies what needs attention, follows through across multiple stakeholders, and takes ownership of getting things done.
Because M'RHEN is a small and growing company, there is no hierarchy of tasks. You should be equally comfortable preparing financial reports, coordinating with an accountant or production partner, managing a VIP client request, organizing the founder's international travel, or preparing the showroom ahead of an appointment.
For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to become a trusted operating partner to the founder while gaining firsthand exposure to the commercial, financial, creative, and operational decisions involved in building a luxury fashion house.

BUSINESS & FINANCIAL OPERATIONS

Maintain day-to-day financial visibility across the business, including expense tracking, receipt management, accounts payable and receivable, reconciliations, and cash-flow reporting.
Coordinate vendor payments, client invoicing, and payment follow-up.
Maintain organized financial records and liaise with the brand's external accountant on bookkeeping, tax preparation, reporting, and related financial administration.
Work with production and the founder to maintain visibility into production costs, margins, inventory value, and collection-level spending.
Prepare financial and operational information to support the founder's budgeting, cash-planning, and collection-planning decisions.
Coordinate payroll, insurance, business filings, and basic HR and compliance administration.
Build and maintain operational systems for expenses, inventory, reporting, documentation, and internal communication.
Identify operational gaps and proactively implement better processes as the company grows.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Manage the founder's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily priorities, anticipating needs and protecting the founder's time.
Coordinate domestic and international travel, itineraries, reservations, and transportation with precision.
Handle personal errands and administrative needs with discretion and follow-through.
Maintain organization across documents, contracts, receipts, records, and internal systems.
Liaise with factories, freelancers, PR teams, stylists, consultants, and external partners on behalf of the founder.
Track key follow-ups, deadlines, and outstanding decisions across the business, ensuring priorities move forward.
Prepare materials, information, and briefings needed for meetings and decision-making.
Support day-to-day operational needs and special priorities as they arise.

INVENTORY & ECOMMERCE OPERATIONS

Oversee accurate and timely fulfillment of ecommerce and client orders.
Maintain visibility into studio inventory, garment movements, and stock levels.
Maintain accurate inventory records and flag discrepancies or low-stock positions.
Coordinate sample trafficking, messenger pickups, shipments, returns, and inventory transfers.
Coordinate with studio and production partners to ensure garments and samples are where they need to be.
Support Shopify and other ecommerce operations and workflows as needed.

SHOWROOM & CLIENT EXPERIENCE

Manage and service showroom appointments with warmth, professionalism, discretion, and a strong eye for styling.
Serve as a first point of contact for VIP clients and custom-order inquiries, gathering details, communicating timelines, and escalating decisions to the founder when appropriate.
Communicate with clients via email and phone with exceptional care and precision.
Support gifting, hospitality, alterations, special orders, and order coordination to maintain an elevated client experience.
Maintain showroom presentation, including merchandising, steaming, organization, and restocking.
Support trunk shows, pop-ups, photoshoots, market appointments, and other brand events.

SPECIAL PROJECTS

As a close operating partner to the founder, the Executive & Business Operations Manager will support projects that fall outside a traditional job description. These may include research, vendor sourcing, events, new operational systems, market preparation, client initiatives, and other priorities that arise as the company grows.
The ability to take an ambiguous problem, determine what needs to happen, and drive it toward completion is essential.

QUALIFICATIONS

2–4 years of relevant professional experience; experience in fashion, luxury, retail, hospitality, or another highly detail-oriented environment strongly preferred.
Prior experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, executive, or creative leader is a strong plus.
Strong operational instincts and demonstrated ability to create structure, maintain systems, and follow projects through to completion.
Comfortable working with numbers and financial information, with a working knowledge of bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, and basic financial reporting.
Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software is a plus.
Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
High level of discretion, judgment, and professionalism; comfortable handling sensitive business, financial, client, and personal information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong client-facing presence and comfort interacting with high-end clientele and senior external partners.
A critical eye for garments, presentation, fit, and styling.
Proactive, resourceful, and calm under pressure, with the instinct to identify what needs to happen rather than waiting to be assigned every task.
Comfortable moving fluidly between high-level and hands-on responsibilities.
Familiarity with Shopify, Google Workspace, Notion, Airtable, or similar platforms is a plus.
Based in New York City with flexibility for occasional evenings and weekends during events, shoots, and market periods.

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

You may be a particularly strong fit if you naturally notice what is missing, create a system for it, and follow through without needing repeated direction.
You are interested not only in fashion, but in how a fashion business actually works
. You want exposure to the decisions behind product, clients, operations, finance, production, PR, and growth—and you are willing to do the detailed work required to understand them.
You are comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can shift quickly and no two days look exactly the same. You enjoy being close to the action, operating with a high level of trust, and becoming increasingly valuable as you develop a deeper understanding of the founder and the business.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Please send a brief introduction and your resume to info@m-rhen.com
with the subject line “Executive & Business Operations Manager — M'RHEN.”

In your introduction, please tell us briefly why you are interested in working inside an emerging luxury fashion company and share one example of a time you took ownership of a problem without being told exactly how to solve it.
We review applications on a rolling basis and will be in touch with candidates whose experience aligns closely with the role.

Update tuition and discount data based on the projected enrollment and approved financial aids. 
Enter the Board/Vestry approved budgets in QuickBooks.

Support annual DASL (Data Analysis for School Leadership) data entries and generate custom financial/data reports as requested.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration is required or highly preferred 
3+ years of experience in accounting & payroll operations, preferably within an independent school or non-profit environment. 
Hands-on experience with school management databases (Veracross, Ravenna, QBO, Stripe, Squarespace, and Benevity). 
Understanding of tuition billing cycles, payroll processing, month-end closing, and non-profit/fund accounting practices. 
Strong skills in Microsoft office Excel / Google Drive
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with empathy and clarity when communicating to parents, church members, and staff; ability to take direction, multitask, and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
Work both independently and collaboratively, maintain strict confidentiality, and enthusiastically support the organizations’ missions, values, and visions. 
Systems Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability to evaluate software workflows, reduce operational friction, and document standard operating procedures (SOPs).

POSITION SUMMARY

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, multi-product enterprise software implementations and service projects within agreed scope and timelines. This role requires an individual who can effectively manage numerous concurrent projects across departments, engage confidently with a broad range of stakeholders from technical teams to executive leadership and apply a consultative, client-centric approach that balances a strong sense of urgency with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive projects to successful, on-time completion.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Effectively manage complex, multi-product enterprise software implementations involving numerous stakeholders, including technical teams and executive-level leadership.
Proactively identify potential issues, risks, and opportunities, communicating them clearly and driving them to resolution before they impact the project.
Serve as a client-centric partner, balancing a consultative style with a strong sense of urgency to keep projects on track and meet deadlines.
Influence and align project stakeholders across functions and levels of the organization, even without direct authority, to keep projects moving forward.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Implementation Consultants, Product Management, and company leadership to ensure a seamless client experience from sale through delivery.
Ensure project schedules, strategies, and collateral are developed and implemented for each project.
Manage project team utilization, margin, and variance.
Ensure that project schedules are consistently up to date.
Create smooth handoffs between groups or organizations involved in a project.
Ensure that escalation of risks or roadblocks is timely, thorough, and accurate.
Maintain and aspire to exceed team and company goals.
Continually seek opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and deepen client relationships.
Other duties as assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree (emphasis in a technical, project management, or business-related field)
At least 5 years of project management experience.
Demonstrated success leading implementation projects and hitting milestone deliverables.
Demonstrated success with structured methodologies associated with business processes, needs analysis, and systems analysis.
Demonstrated project management skills including developing client relationships, taking ownership responsibility, and successful project completion.

Demonstrated ability to proactively identify risks and drive issues to resolution before they impact project timelines.
Strong consultative and relationship-building skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and align stakeholders across functions and levels of an organization without direct authority.
Travel as needed, (approx. 25%)

Problem Solving

Peer Feedback - Peer feedback helps individuals better understand strengths and weaknesses, allowing individuals to continue favorable behaviors and work on areas for improvement.

Time to value and successful adoption post project close

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - Denmark - Global Expansion
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.
Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.
Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.
Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life.
Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact.
Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.
Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.
Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap.
Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers.
Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Requirements

3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. Direct enterprise customer experience is preferred.
Experience in product development, delivery, and change management
Commercial instinct: comfort engaging in deal conversations, structuring value propositions, and navigating enterprise sales cycles alongside GTM partners.
Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with API integration, sufficient to prototype, demo, and communicate credibly with engineering teams.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions.
A proven track record of taking ownership of complex, ambiguous projects and delivering results.
Adaptability to work across different customer environments, industries, and technical use cases.
Technical aptitude and familiarity with common LLM, tooling and AI agent frameworks.
Ability to creatively map enterprise use cases and workflows to AI systems

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Denmark, with a preference of Copenhagen. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Danish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Staff Product Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all.

This role will partner closely with our Software and Design teams to define the vision and long-term strategy for Aurora's internal application ecosystem for Autonomy development. You will be responsible for the end-to-end product lifecycle of tools that empower our engineers and operations teams to build, test, and deploy autonomous vehicle technology at scale. By conducting deep user research and synthesizing complex requirements, you will transform technical capabilities into a cohesive product portfolio that accelerates our path to commercialization.

In this role, you will

Architect Product Strategy: Define and champion a multi-year product vision and North Star for a portfolio of internal applications, ensuring alignment with Aurora’s broader commercial objectives.
Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary bridge between Engineering and Design to deliver high-impact products that maximize business value and optimize user workflows.
Master the User Domain: Develop an empathetic, deep-seated understanding of the challenges inherent in AV development, including data visualization, ML labeling, and simulation lifecycles.
Drive AI Adoption: Define and champion AI/agentic tools and workflows that accelerate development workflows
Prioritize for Impact: Rigorously manage the product roadmap, balancing the immediate needs of internal stakeholders with long-term platform scalability and technical debt.
Operationalize Feedback: Translate qualitative user insights and quantitative usage metrics into high-fidelity requirements and actionable user stories.
Lead Through Influence: Navigate complex stakeholder environments to build consensus on timelines, trade-offs, and resource allocation.

Required Qualifications

Proven Leadership: 7+ years in software product management with a track record of driving the strategy and execution of complex software ecosystems.
Strategic Problem Solver: Exceptional ability to navigate ambiguity, create structured frameworks from "white space," and lead teams through organizational change.
Influence & Communication: Ability to articulate a compelling product narrative and translate sophisticated concepts into clear, persuasive communication for executive leadership.
Collaborative Excellence: Demonstrated experience leading high-performing, cross-functional teams (Design, Engineering, and Data) to deliver high-ROI products.
Operational Fluency: Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, particularly in ML-based software development, and the ability to identify and mitigate delivery risks.
Technical Fluency: Ability to pick up deep technical concepts quickly to understand architecture risks and complexity trade-offs.

Desirable Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or other technical education) or equivalent practical experience
Experience shipping products
Experience with self-driving technology or other AI-based applications

For roles based in Mountain View, CA and San Francisco, CA: The salary range for this position is $187,000 - $262,000 per year.

For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA: The salary range for this position is $163,000 - $236,000 per year.

Aurora's pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate's starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

Our commitment to safety

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

Our commitment to inclusion

Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech.

For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.
